text: Covariances psi theta estimated using LDL’ decomposition positive definite covariance matrix. decomposition expresses covariance matrix Σ\Sigma as𝚺=(𝐋+𝐈)diag(Softplus(𝐝uc))(𝐋+𝐈)′,\begin{equation}   \boldsymbol{\Sigma} = \left( \mathbf{L} + \mathbf{} \right) \mathrm{diag} \left( \mathrm{Softplus} \left( \mathbf{d}_{uc} \right) \right) \left( \mathbf{L} + \mathbf{} \right)^{\prime}, \end{equation} : - 𝐋\mathbf{L} strictly lower-triangular matrix free parameters (l_mat_strict), - 𝐈\mathbf{} identity matrix, - 𝐝uc\mathbf{d}_{uc} unconstrained vector, - Softplus(𝐝uc)=log⁡(1+exp(𝐝uc))\mathrm{Softplus} \left(\mathbf{d}_{uc} \right) = \log \left(1 + \exp \left( \mathbf{d}_{uc} \right) \right) ensures strictly positive diagonal entries. LDL() function extracts decomposition positive definite covariance matrix. returns: - d_uc: unconstrained diagonal parameters, equal InvSoftplus(d_vec), - d_vec: diagonal entries, equal Softplus(d_uc), - l_mat_strict: strictly lower-triangular factor.
